notes: gUnk_08D63C28[RoomProps.unk22] (287 pointers): what the CPU-controlled helper Kirbys path on in a room. An editor that changes a room's geometry must regenerate it (node map + all-pairs next-hop matrix) or the helpers will steer into walls; the format is fully decoded except the node tail and the script opcodes.

records.description: Per-room AI navigation graph and helper scripts.

fields.name: scripts
fields.description: 4 pointers (this is unk0[4], offsets 0..15): one u16 bytecode script per player id, run by the CPU-Kirby interpreter (switch over opcodes 0..0xA, 0xFFFF = halt; inline u16 operands; opcode 8 is a relative jump). Opcode meanings are not decoded.

evidence.data: first opcode of 1104 of the 1148 scripts is 0x000A

fields.name: nodeMap
fields.description: RL-compressed grid with the collision map's geometry: one node index per 16x16 cell (0xFF = no node). Decompressed into gUnk_02026D60[slot] at load.

evidence.data: room 803: 988 cells (= its collision grid), values 0..19 against numNodes 20

fields.name: numNodes
fields.description: Node count (the next-hop row is 32 wide, so at most 32).

records.description: A waypoint of the nav graph.

fields.name: nextHop
fields.description: nextHop[dest] = the neighbouring node to move to next to reach node dest from this node; 0xFF = unreachable. An all-pairs routing table.

evidence.note: unk1A = node Kirby stands in (from the node map), unk1B = chosen destination

fields.name: arriveRadius
fields.description: Chebyshev distance to the current target node within which the helper suppresses its next steering action (treats the node as reached).

NOT filler: byte 0x28 is the node's own index (5057/5057 nodes), followed by an 0xFF-terminated list of node indices (looks like an authoring-time adjacency list the next-hop table was built from). No reader in game/src. Preserve.
